title: SFX policies (voice-first)
principle: Prefer xAI speech tags over sound effects. SFX is punctuation, not a score under the hosts.
bans_global: constant music beds under dialogue (except the musical genre's explicit bed policy)
SFX that drown a number the host is saying

none.notes: Speech tags only. Use for interviews that should feel like a room.

voice-first-sparse.notes: Default. ≤1 of each named kind. Roberto further caps total accents at 3 per 4–6 min.

bed_rules: Bed only in pre-roll / outro or under a sung interlude, never under spoken argument.
Duck at least 12 dB under any speech.

comedy-accents.notes: Denser hits allowed. Still no laugh track — hosts laugh with tags.

musical-beds.notes: Beds and hummed/sung tags are in-genre. Still duck under spoken turns.

sfx_budget.instructions: What SFX budget should this episode use, given genre and the written plan?

criteria.none: No non-speech audio. Speech tags carry everything. Interview-in-a-room, or the script is already busy.
criteria.sting-only: At most a cold-open hit and an outro. No ding, no whoosh.
criteria.light-bed: Sparse accents plus an optional bed that never sits under argument. Musical or branded shows only.
criteria.reject_noisy: The proposed plan has constant beds, meme whooshes, laugh tracks, or more accents than the preset cap.
